Steiniger Uferstreifen. Parken 2,50 €/Tag, Wohnmobil 12 €/Nacht. HUNDE verboten.

How the weather is rated

the rules behind the rating

Swipe sideways.

VariableSourceRule
Thunderstormweather_codeCode 95, 96, 99 (thunderstorm, with or without hail) — the hour is excluded entirely. Hours up to 2 h before and after are downgraded to 40 % and noted in the session.
Thunderstorm potentialcapeFrom 1200 J/kg downgraded to 70 % with a note, from 2000 J/kg to 35 %. CAPE warns where the model doesn’t yet output a thunderstorm hour.
RainprecipitationBelow 0.6 mm/h no deduction, then falling linearly up to 3.0 mm/h, above that down to 20 %.
Air temperaturetemperature_2mOutside 7–35 °C the hour is excluded. Within 3 °C of a limit, downgraded to 80 %.
Water temperaturesea_surface_temperatureBelow 7 °C the hour is excluded — but only with --marine and only at sea and lagoon spots. There is no source for inland lakes.
Tidesea_level_height_mslWater level from the marine model (8 km grid, not an official tide table) — at sea and lagoon spots with a tidal range, or where tidal: true is set in the catalogue. Without a tide window, display only; with tide: fahrbar, hours outside the window are excluded.
Daylightsunrise / sunset30 min after sunrise to 30 min before sunset.
Cloud covercloud_coverFetched but not rated — it makes no difference to the session.
Where a fetch rose exists, wind angle and wave height come from the OpenStreetMap shoreline geometry: fetch over water in 36 directions, giving offshore / side-shore / onshore and the wave height via the fetch-limited SPM relation. This is an approximation — it assumes steady wind and uses U10. Hand-maintained sectors in spots.yaml take priority. Wind, gusts, temperature, rain, CAPE and weather code from Open-Meteo (free, non-commercial plan). Wind direction sectors, water state, seagrass and standing depth come from spots.yaml — hand-maintained and not yet verified. Drive time is routed where OSRM responds, otherwise estimated from the straight-line distance — which of the two applies is shown in the drive-time tooltip at each destination. All wind values in knots, all times in the local time of the respective spot.
